title: Whiteboard background templates with create-board picker and in-board toggle

requirements.summary: Load and apply a per-board backgroundMode (blank/dots/grid/lines) from board metadata so collaborators see the same mode on open/join.
acceptanceCriteria: A board has a backgroundMode value that is one of: "blank" | "dots" | "grid" | "lines".
When two different clients open the same board, both see the same background mode.
Changing the background mode persists for the board and remains after refresh/reload.

file_operations.description: Add board-level UI state for backgroundMode and actions to set/update it (separate from element operations), so the selected mode can be stored locally and rendered consistently.

Update snapshot loading to read the board background from the snapshot response and set backgroundMode in the store; when creating a missing board, pass an initial background choice (defaulting to blank) so metadata is created consistently.
Extend polling sync to apply background changes from the server response (in addition to operations/version), updating the store when the backgroundMode changes so collaborators converge via polling.
Read backgroundMode from the board store and pass it into canvas rendering so the loaded board metadata is reflected visually for all users.

Align the frontend backend-call wrapper with the current backend interface for board creation and background operations (createBoard expects a background argument; also expose updateBoardBackground if needed by UI).

requirements.summary: Render Blank/Dots/Grid/Lines backgrounds behind all elements, anchored to world-space during pan/zoom.
acceptanceCriteria: Blank mode renders a clean solid background.
Dots mode renders an evenly-spaced dot pattern.
Grid mode renders evenly-spaced square grid lines.
Lines mode renders evenly-spaced horizontal ruled lines.
When the user pans/zooms, the background pattern stays aligned with the drawing world coordinates (no drifting relative to existing strokes/shapes).

file_operations.description: Add background rendering before elements based on backgroundMode (blank/dots/grid/lines), computing pattern offsets from the current viewport so the pattern is anchored to world coordinates under pan/zoom.
Update renderCanvas invocation to provide backgroundMode along with elements/viewport so the renderer can draw the correct template behind all elements.

requirements.summary: Add a Create New Board modal with board name input and template tile picker (Blank/Dots/Grid/Lines), then navigate into the new board with that template applied.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking “Create Board” on the home screen opens a modal with: board name input + template selection tiles (Blank/Dots/Grid/Lines) + Cancel + Create Board.
Create Board is disabled until a valid board name is entered (non-empty after trim).
After creating, the app navigates to the new board and the selected background is visible immediately.
Recent boards list continues to function.

file_operations.description: Implement the Create New Board modal UI (name input, template selection tiles, Cancel/Create actions). Use shadcn-ui Dialog/Input/Button components to match the intended layout; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire the CreateBoardDialog into the existing HomePage 'Create Board' action to open the modal and, on success, generate a new boardId and navigate to that board with the chosen name + template; keep the recent boards section working.
Extend navigation state to pass optional create-board initialization (initial title + initial background template) from HomePage into BoardPage, without adding new routes.

Accept optional initialTitle/initialBackground props, initialize the displayed boardTitle accordingly, and pass initialBackground into snapshot creation/loading so the new board opens with the selected template immediately.
Support an optional initialBackground parameter so when a board does not exist yet, creation uses the selected template; ensure the returned snapshot background is applied to the store on load.

requirements.summary: Add an in-board control to switch the shared board background template and sync it via polling without affecting existing elements.
acceptanceCriteria: A user can change the background mode from within the board UI.
The change is persisted to the backend and is reflected on another client after sync/polling.
Switching background does not modify or delete existing whiteboard elements.

file_operations.description: Add a background/template selector control (e.g., dropdown/overflow menu) to switch between Blank/Dots/Grid/Lines. Use shadcn-ui DropdownMenu to present the options; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Expose a typed frontend call for updating the board background (wrapping the backend capability) so the top bar control can persist backgroundMode changes.
Add an action to set backgroundMode immediately on user selection (optimistic UI), ensuring it does not touch element state/history.
Ensure backgroundMode changes made by any collaborator are observed and applied during polling sync, so other clients update their background without modifying existing whiteboard elements.
